findings.invariant: P4 signed projection/request fingerprint uses the validated retained descriptor identity throughout the operation.
findings.counterexample: An implementation can fix selectors but retain subsequent mutable published.descriptor reads. A racing single handle-descriptor poke after validation changes signed P4 validation/fingerprinting identity.
findings.disposition: Independent convergence addendum and full retained snapshot propagation matrix correction before new Phase0.
